caption: A saucer that has been covering a steaming mug of tea is lifted off, and a puff of steam escapes while the saucer's underside is beaded with drops.

sa.check: A saucer covers a mug of tea.
A puff of steam escapes from the mug.
The saucer's underside is beaded with drops.
The drops run to the saucer's lowest point as it tilts.
The lift comes first and the puff follows.

pc.expect: The puff escapes as the saucer lifts and not before, and the saucer's underside is wet where the steam met it.
pc.fail: The puff escapes while the saucer still sits flat on the mug; or the saucer lifts and no steam leaves the mug at all; or the saucer's underside is dry after covering a steaming mug; or the drops lie on the saucer's upper face while its underside is dry.

pc.expect: The puff rises from the mug while the drops on the saucer run to its lowest point and hang or fall from there.
pc.fail: The puff sinks over the mug's rim and pools on the table; or the drops run up toward the saucer's raised side; or a drop leaves the saucer and rises; or drops stay fixed in place on a steeply tilted saucer.

pc.expect: The steam keeps leaving the mug and the drops on the saucer only gather, run and fall.
pc.fail: The puff runs back into the mug; or a puff retreats to the tea; or the saucer's underside beads up again while held clear of the steam; or a fallen drop returns to the saucer.

pc.expect: The drops behave as water on china: rounded, merging when they touch and running as streaks, and the saucer stays a rigid disc.
pc.fail: Touching drops overlap without merging; or drops jump about on the saucer; or the drops set as frost on the warm china; or the saucer bends as it lifts.

pc.expect: One mug and one saucer; the drops come from the tea's steam and the tea stays in the mug.
pc.fail: The tea's level jumps; or a second saucer appears; or the saucer passes through the mug's rim; or tea passes through the mug's wall.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The mug's pattern, the saucer and the table stay the same.
pc.fail: The mug's pattern changes; or the saucer changes colour; or items on the table rearrange.
